headline: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok and Cursor into one subscription
summary: SpaceXSI announced a new bundled subscription that combines X Premium with AI tools Grok, Grok Bot and Cursor. Plans for the new X Subscription range from $8 to $200 per month.

sources.quote: SpaceXSI has announced a new subscription scheme that gives you access to Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor and X Premium.
